name: Sichuan Kelun-Biotech Biopharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
summary: Sichuan Kelun-Biotech Biopharmaceutical Co., Ltd., a biopharmaceutical company, engages in the research and development, manufacturing, and commercialization of novel drugs in oncology, immunology, metabolism, and other therapeutic areas in the People's Republic of China and internationally.
